SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_503A_REZN_C.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Are you trying to get us killed!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_504A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Stay with me.
The area is full of German patrols!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_506A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7We cannot afford to be drawn
into needless battles.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_508A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7A hunter has to stay hidden from his prey!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_510A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Killing Amsel is worth more than any other life...
Including yours.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_703A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Our comrades are clearing the building!
Watch your fire!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_704A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Follow me... I know a perfect sniping position
overlooking the command post.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_707A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The death of General Amsel
will be just the beginning...

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_708B_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is hiding behind the destroyed tank!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_708C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is hiding behind the destroyed tank!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_709A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's using the destroyed tank for cover!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_709B_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is using the destroyed tank for cover!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_709C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is using the destroyed tank for cover!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_711A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's using the burning truck for cover!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_712B_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is cowering behind the artillery piece!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_712C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is cowering behind the artillery piece!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_713B_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is using the halftrack for cover!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_713C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is using the halftrack for cover!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_714B_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is taking cover by the halftrack!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_714C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is taking cover by the halftrack!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_718A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7You must first kill his sniper to get a clear shot!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_726A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep moving before it tears us apart!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_806A_DALE.en: ^1DALETSKI: ^7Take positions and wait for the signal...

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_807A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7You see?!! They will still die and now
you have given away our position!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_809A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Only a true marksman nails his
target with no scope!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_900A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri! If you tire of sniping you can
use the mounted MG!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_902A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Watch the building.
He will be coming out any second now.

SUBTITLE_US_1_ORDER_ATTACK_INFANTRY_05.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7This is it Marines, let's get them!

SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_00B.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Everything that was asked
of us, we've done.

SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_01B.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Every night we lay in a filthy foxhole...
Prayin' the enemy won't slit our throats.

SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_02B.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Every day we spent crawling
through the mud and dirt 
while bullets whistled all around.

SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_03C.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7But this is the last time we're
gonna have to put our lives on the line.

SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_04B.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7This is the enemy's last stand.
When we take Shuri Castle, we go home.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_A_VIDEO11.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7With the line at Seelow now broken, nothing stands between the Red Army and Berlin.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_A_VIDEO12.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Every day, we carve deeper into German territory.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_A_VIDEO13.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Every day, fear and desperation erode their will.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_A_VIDEO14.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7When our train reaches Berlin, they will have nowhere left to hide.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_B_VIDEO11.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Our grip tightens around the black heart of Berlin.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_B_VIDEO12.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The Fuhrer demands all to shed their last drop of blood in it's defense.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_B_VIDEO14.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7If they stand for Germany...  They die for Germany.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_B_VIDEO15.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Building by building...  Room by room...  One rat at a time.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_C_VIDEO11.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The Red army encircles the Reichstag - their parliament building and final stronghold of the fascist Reich.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_C_VIDEO12.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7In the surrounding streets we choke the life from those who would still dare to defend it.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_C_VIDEO13.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7It is an honor and a privilege to play a part in this glorious battle.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_C_VIDEO14.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7When our flag flies over the city, our enemy's defeat and humiliation will be beyond question.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_D_VIDEO11.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The path towards our glorious victory has been a journey of blood and brutality.

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_D_VIDEO14.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7When the flag of our Motherland flies atop the Reichstag...

VIDSUBTITLES_BERLIN_D_VIDEO15.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7All of Berlin will know that the evil of the Fascist reich has been wiped from the face of the earth.

VIDSUBTITLES_MAKIN_VIDEO11.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Makin Atoll - little more than sand, trees and a small Japanese Military base.

VIDSUBTITLES_MAKIN_VIDEO12.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller's reconnaissance team landed there almost a week ago. Since then - we've heard nothing.

VIDSUBTITLES_MAKIN_VIDEO13.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7The waiting's over, we're going in. For all we know they're already dead.

VIDSUBTITLES_MAKIN_VIDEO14.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7If what little we know about the Japanese is true, it might be better if they are.

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_A_VIDEO12.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7The last few months on Okinawa have taken their toll...

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_A_VIDEO14.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7It's the rain, sir... and the mud.

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_A_VIDEO17.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We can't even get the wounded out.

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_B_VIDEO11.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Everything that was asked of us - we've done.

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_B_VIDEO12.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Every night we lay in a filthy foxhole - prayin' the enemy won't slit our throats.

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_B_VIDEO13.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Every day we spent crawling through the mud and the dirt while bullets whistled all around.

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_B_VIDEO15.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7But this is the last time we're gonna have to put our lives on the line.

VIDSUBTITLES_OKINAWA_B_VIDEO16.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7This is the enemy's last stand. When we take Shuri Castle, we go home.

VIDSUBTITLES_OUTRO_VIDEO12.en:
^1PRESIDENT TRUMAN: ^7that the forces of Germany
have surrendered to the United Nations.

VIDSUBTITLES_OUTRO_VIDEO13.en:
^1PRESIDENT TRUMAN: ^7The victory won in the West,
must now be won in the East.

VIDSUBTITLES_OUTRO_VIDEO15.en: ^1GENERAL MACARTHUR: ^7representatives of the major warring powers,

VIDSUBTITLES_OUTRO_VIDEO19.en: ^1GENERAL MACARTHUR: ^7and indeed the hope of all mankind,

VIDSUBTITLES_OUTRO_VIDEO21.en:
^1GENERAL MACARTHUR: ^7a better world shall emerge out
of the blood and carnage of the past.

VIDSUBTITLES_OUTRO_VIDEO22.en: ^1GENERAL MACARTHUR: ^7A world founded upon faith and understanding,

VIDSUBTITLES_OUTRO_VIDEO23.en:
^1GENERAL MACARTHUR: ^7of man and the fufillment 
of his most cherished wish,

VIDSUBTITLES_PBY_VIDEO11.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7The battle of Peleliu finally came to an end in November of 1944.

VIDSUBTITLES_PBY_VIDEO12.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Three bitter months after it was supposed to.

VIDSUBTITLES_PBY_VIDEO13.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7When we shipped out for Okinawa, the airfield became a vital asset in the campaign.

VIDSUBTITLES_PBY_VIDEO14.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Among those stationed there are the  crews of US Navy Black Cats.

VIDSUBTITLES_PBY_VIDEO15.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Men who would risk everything before they would leave any of us in enemy waters.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_A_VIDEO11.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Years after the raid on Makin, we're heading up an all out assault on Peleliu Island...

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_A_VIDEO12.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7No POW's to rescue this time... Our mission: take the airfield and cripple their supply network.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_A_VIDEO14.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7The older guys like Miller, Sergeant Sullivan and myself, we're known as "The old breed".

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_A_VIDEO15.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7"Old"... we're not even out of our twenties.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_B_VIDEO11.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Though we've taken the airfield, the enemy still hold onto most of the inland areas of the island.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_B_VIDEO12.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7A maze of trenches and artillery positions run right through the this whole Godforsaken rock.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_B_VIDEO13.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7The enemy's dug in deep, and we have to get our hands dirty.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_C_VIDEO11.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Getting this far has been tougher than any of us could ever have imagined.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_C_VIDEO12.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Taking the airfield and the mortar pits showed us 
that the enemy will fight to the death for every last inch of this rock.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_C_VIDEO13.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7They're making their last stand in the jungles and caves that surround the heavy guns on the point.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_C_VIDEO14.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We take them... and we take Peleliu.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_D_VIDEO11.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're all numbed by Sullivan's death.  We just never saw it coming, I still can't believe it.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_D_VIDEO12.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7The most solid, dependable and courageous Marine we've ever known. Blink of an eye, gone.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_D_VIDEO13.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Now it's down to me, and me alone, to lead these men, my brothers, safely through this campaign.

VIDSUBTITLES_PELELIU_D_VIDEO14.en: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7AA fire from Peleliu airfield is knocking our planes right out the sky. Taking this airfield is our only priority.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_A_VIDEO11.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The Red Army's advance into Germany is swift and brutal.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_A_VIDEO12.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7In mere months, we have reached Seelow Heights - the last line of defense before the German capital.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_A_VIDEO13.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We outnumber the Germans ten to one!  Wave upon wave of our infantry are unleashed upon them to clear the way for our armor.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_A_VIDEO14.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Once we have control of Seelow, we will begin the march to Berlin.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_A_VIDEO15.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7There, we will ensure that every sacrifice is repaid in blood.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_B_VIDEO11.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We have lost many brave men, but their sacrifice is not in vain.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_B_VIDEO12.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Our tanks now form a line of steel so powerful that all German resistance will be crushed beneath its mighty treads.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_B_VIDEO13.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Today - We will watch as Seelow falls.

VIDSUBTITLES_SEELOW_B_VIDEO14.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Along with all those foolish enough to stand in our way.

VIDSUBTITLES_SNIPER_VIDEO11.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The rotten cancer of the fascist Reich ravages Europe like a plague.

VIDSUBTITLES_SNIPER_VIDEO12.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Their relentless drive into our motherland steals the lives of men, women and children alike.

VIDSUBTITLES_SNIPER_VIDEO13.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The arrogance of their leaders is matched only by the brutality of their soldiers.

VIDSUBTITLES_SNIPER_VIDEO14.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7These are the darkest days of the Nazi occupation of Stalingrad.
